bull_bear.body:
- Consolidated net worth of INR 1,341 Crs and Debt/Equity of 1.52x at Q1 FY27; net worth progression INR 1,095.7 Crs (FY24), 1,217.2 (FY25), 1,304.0 (FY26), 1,340.7 (Q1 FY27).
- Credit ratings: "Short Term- ICRA A1+" and "Long Term- ICRA A & CRISIL A (STABLE)".
- NBFC capitalisation strengthened while the book shrank: CRAR 35.0% (FY24), 37.0% (FY25), 43.2% (FY26), 47.6% (Q1 FY27).
- Returns have compressed over the historical period shown: ROCE 18.5% (FY24), 14.8% (FY25), 11.5% (FY26); ROE 18.6% (FY24), 12.7% (FY25), 8.2% (FY26).
- Funding mix shifted toward capital markets: consolidated Debt Securities rose from INR 39.7 Crs (Mar-24) to 154.4 (Mar-25) and 385.3 Crs (Mar-26), with 18 listed debenture scrip codes; borrowings other than debt securities were INR 1,612.9 Crs at Mar-26.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- "Evolution from Traditional Broking to well diversified Financial Service Company": founded in 1994 by Mr. Subhash C. Aggarwal and Mr. Mahesh C. Gupta, initially focusing on traditional broking services, with a stated "Strategic Shift: Transformed from traditional broking to a diversified financial services powerhouse".
- Key strengths cited: "Comprehensive Financial Offerings with High Margin Business: SMC offers a diverse range of high-margin financial products under one roof"; "Established National Brand"; "Fintech Focused Approach"; and "Experienced Leadership - Top Management of SMC has Over 30 Years of experience in industry".
- Distribution moat as described: "Our expansive network includes 1,935 authorized persons, spanning 383 cities and 6,360 financial distributors across India"; "SMC is a clearing member in all major exchanges".
- Bank-channel alliances: "SMC has a strategic alliance with 8 PSU and Private Banks offering Online Trading services to their customers vis PNB, UBI, CBI, IOB, Ujjivan bank etc." plus a "3-in-1 tie-up (Bank & Demat Account facility provided by the bank to its customer and Trading account facility will be provided by the SMC)".
- Stated future outlook: "Global aspirations; emphasis on fee-based income; continued adaptation and innovation", with a GIFT City IFSC presence (NSE IX | India INX | IIBX) and 198 branches "Including 1 in Dubai".
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Bonus issue] Share capital doubled from INR 20.9 Crs (Mar-25) to INR 41.9 Crs (Mar-26); the deck repeatedly footnotes "*Historical EPS/Shares adjusted for 1:1 bonus issue (Nov 2025)".
- [Accounting basis] Insurance segment figures carry the footnote "*Revenue recognition changed from net to gross basis from FY18" - insurance revenue is therefore not comparable to a net-basis presentation.
- [Group structure] Operating subsidiaries listed: Moneywise Financial Services Private Limited (NBFC) 100%, SMC Insurance Brokers Private Limited 90%, Moneywise Finvest Limited (StoxKart, discount brokerage) 100%, SMC Capitals Limited (Category-1 Merchant Banker) 100%, SMC Global IFSC Private Limited 100%, SMC Investech Private Limited (formerly SMC Real Estate Advisors) 100%, Pulin Comtrade Limited 100%, SMC Comex International DMCC (UAE) 100%, SMC Investments & Advisors Limited 100%.
- [Regulatory classification] The financing business is presented as an NBFC in the "Middle Layer" of the scale-based regulatory framework.
- [Promoter/family management] The management slides show a largely promoter-family bench (Aggarwal and Gupta families) heading the group entities, with Mr. Subhash C. Aggarwal as Chairman & Managing Director and Mr. Mahesh C. Gupta as Vice Chairman & Managing Director of SMC Group.
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions SMC Global Securities as a 1994-founded, technology-led "diversified financial services powerhouse" that has evolved from traditional broking into three reported segments - Broking, Distribution & Trading; Insurance Broking; and Financing (NBFC) - operating through a hybrid physical-plus-digital network across 383 cities and a group of wholly/majority owned subsidiaries.
